Season 2: Episode N'') is the third arc of {{aniseries|BW}} that aired on {{wp|TV Tokyo}} from January 17, 2013 to April 18, 2013. It follows ''[[Best Wishes! Season 2]]'' and precedes ''[[Decolora Adventure!|Season 2: Decolora Adventure!]]''. This arc centers on the mysterious {{an|N}} and his connection to [[Team Plasma]]. {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} return to western [[Unova]], where they encounter N, a young man able to hear the hearts of Pokémon. He joins their journey as they investigate Team Plasma’s plans to control Pokémon, culminating in a confrontation at the {{an|White Ruins}} involving {{an|Reshiram}}. The opening theme is [[Be an Arrow!#Opening animation: Version 2 (BW109 – BW122)|Be an Arrow! 2013]], a remixed version of [[Be an Arrow!]], performed by [[Rica Matsumoto]] and the ending theme is [[Sakura Go-Round]] performed by {{wp|Shiritsu Ebisu Chugaku}}. {{spoilers}} ==Plot== {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} return to [[Nuvema Town]] to meet [[Professor Juniper]], who informs them about a new Gym in [[Aspertia City]]. The [[Team Rocket trio]] also returns to Unova to continue their pursuit of {{AP|Pikachu}}. The group then begins traveling toward the {{an|White Ruins}}, where the legendary {{p|Reshiram}} is said to dwell. Along the way, Ash and his friends meet {{an|N}}, a mysterious young man who can sense Pokémon’s emotions. N joins them, concealing his past ties to [[Team Plasma]]. In [[Aspertia City]], Ash meets [[Cheren]], the city’s new Gym Leader, and loses to him in an unofficial match. Soon after, they meet [[Looker]] and encounter Team Plasma and their scientist [[Colress]]. As their journey progresses, {{AP|Charizard}} rejoins Ash’s team and battles [[Iris's Dragonite]]. N’s history with Team Plasma is gradually revealed through encounters with his foster sisters, [[Anthea and Concordia]], who help him confront his past. N eventually leaves to stop Team Plasma on his own. At the White Ruins, [[Cedric Juniper]] discovers the [[Light Stone]], which N seizes to prevent it from falling into Team Plasma’s hands. [[Ghetsis]] and Colress launch an attack to awaken Reshiram using Colress’s control machine. N surrenders the Light Stone to save Pikachu, allowing Ghetsis to control Reshiram. With help from Anthea, Concordia, and even Team Rocket, Ash and his friends destroy the control machine, freeing Reshiram and the other Pokémon. Looker then arrests Ghetsis, Colress, and the remaining Team Plasma members. N departs with Anthea and Concordia, finally at peace. ==Gallery== ===Promotional material=== Best Wishes Season 2 Episode N poster.png|Poster for ''Best Wishes!
